thread:
ana: Heads up — after rolling the continuous-batching heuristic tweak last night we see a p95 latency jump for small multi-turn requests on the 'chat-lite' model instance. Not huge QPS impact but latency up ~40% and tail is worse. anyone watching? :eyes:
chris: I saw alerts at 02:12. p95 from 110ms -> 155ms for that model shard. p50 mostly stable.
mike: I grabbed a quick flamegraph from the node that spiked. Looks like a kernel fallback path is invoked a lot during microbatches (lots of small seq lengths). Attaching the snippet:```
# flame top 5
1  slow_kernel_exec  38%
2  continuous_batcher::form 18%
3  kv_cache::read_locked 12%
4  copy_to_device 10%
5  scheduler::dequeue 8%
```
ana: @mike do you think batching heuristic is creating too many tiny batches so kernel selector picks slow path?
mike: Yes. The tweak reduced the token_budget threshold to force earlier dispatch for latency SLOs, but for requests that later expand (longer continuations) we end up splitting and losing kernel affinity. Kernel selector then falls back to generic attention kernel.
chris: I also see increased KV cache eviction churn in the same timeframe — eviction rate +22% on that shard. Probably due to microbatching causing more context switches per worker and less reuse.
sekharmonitor: alert: shard-chat-lite-07 eviction_rate > 0.75 for 5m window — triggered 02:13
ana: Ok — so two linked effects: batch formation causing kernel fallback + higher KV churn. That explains tail. Does anyone have a repro to iterate quickly?
mike: I replayed a sampled trace set locally with the new heuristic flags. Repro is consistent. Quick diff of the heuristic params:```
old: token_budget=128, max_wait_ms=18, prefer_kernel_affinity=true
new: token_budget=80,  max_wait_ms=6,  prefer_kernel_affinity=false
```
chris: prefer_kernel_affinity=false is the smoking gun. We disabled affinity to reduce p50 but didn't account for microburst continuity.
mike: Kernel selection logs:```
[2026-03-02T02:11:04Z] batch_id=abcd selector=fast_kernel reasons=(shape_mismatch, kv_miss)
[2026-03-02T02:11:04Z] batch_id=efgh selector=generic_kernel reasons=(tiny_batch)
```
ana: Proposal: flip prefer_kernel_affinity back to true and nudge token_budget to 96, keep max_wait_ms=8 for a compromise. Rollback plan?
chris: Canary revert on one podpool first, measure p95 and eviction_rate. If stable, roll to remaining pools.
deploy-bot: Deploy started: revert-heuristic-prefer-affinity -> eng-runtime/pool-chat-lite-07 (canary) by ana at 1764002000
mike: I'll attach a quick perf test: run 1k sampled sessions with typical continuation distribution. Expect p95 to fall back near previous.
chris: Also add a temporary metric: kernel_fallback_rate per shard so we can alert quicker next time. I'll file a quick dash ticket.
ana: Doing canary now. If anyone sees error budget burn or weird regressions call it out.
sekharmonitor: alert cleared: eviction_rate back to baseline on pool-07 at 02:31
chris: Canary shows p95 back to ~115ms, kernel_fallback_rate down 70%, eviction_rate normalized. Nice.
mike: Follow-ups: 1) add a small integration test that replays continuation-heavy sessions against heuristic changes; 2) add a telemetry tag when kernel selector falls back so we can trace it to batching decisions.
ana: Agreed. I'll open the PRs and a postmortem note. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: Deploy completed: revert-heuristic-prefer-affinity -> eng-runtime/pool-chat-lite-07 at 1764004200
ana: Marking this thread resolved for now. We'll pick up the test/metric items in a follow-up.
